import { describe, expect, it, test } from "vitest";

describe("outer", () => {
  describe("inner", () => {
    it("holds a title two describes deep", () => {
      expect(1).toBe(1);
    });
  });

  it("holds a title one describe deep", () => {
    expect(1).toBe(1);
  });
});

it("shared title", () => {
  expect(1).toBe(1);
});

it("matches ^a (b) [c] + d$", () => {
  expect(1).toBe(1);
});

const suffix = "computed";
it(`a title built from a ${suffix} expression`, () => {
  expect(1).toBe(1);
});

test.each([
  [1, 2],
  [2, 4],
])("doubles %i into %i", (n, want) => {
  expect(n * 2).toBe(want);
});
